summary: Held through the entry frame and an early favorable run to +11, then two mild pullback frames (-1, -8.75) that looked like normal give-back within the established amplitude range so I held. The signal that flipped it: after a brief bounce/chop (-4 to -3.75) price broke to -20.75, more than double the prior worst excursion, on a freshly-started leg showing 0% giveback -- i.e. a sustained one-directional move against the short with no internal recovery, not another dip. Next time I'd watch for that exact pattern earlier: a new leg with zero giveback immediately after a chop phase is the tell that the move has stopped mean-reverting and started trending against the position.
